communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: College of Nursing - Round Rock Campus
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

-Any emails, text messages, or memos sent or received from the following individuals concerning the evaluation, workload determinations, and faculty and leadership position(s) hiring involving and/or affecting the faculty of the College of Nursing Round Rock campus from January 1, 2026 to the present date.
1) Leann Horsely, Dean of the College of Nursing
2) Angela Mulcahy-Spence, Interim Assistant Dean for Undergraduate Nursing Education - Round Rock and McAllen

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

OpenRecordsTransparencyTX
